description: Render Carve to HTML, Markdown, plain text, or ANSI terminal text, with loss reporting.

allowRawHtml.description: Pass trusted raw HTML through on HTML output. Disabled by default.

asciiHeadingIds.description: Heading ID policy; explicit values override the preset.

lowercaseHeadingIds.description: Lowercase generated heading IDs; explicit values override the preset.

preset.description: portable lowercases IDs and transliterates where possible; static-html is HTML-only.

sanitizeUrls.description: Report blocked authored URL schemes as render losses. A dangerous scheme is always blanked; this server never emits one.

smartTypography.description: false is source; { quotes: false } keeps typed quotes only.

strictLosses.description: Fail instead of returning output when a raw-format node would be dropped.

name: carve_render
title: Render Carve
